# Chris Lam

> Product Designer for AI-native products, 14 years. "I design & code to ship products." y30 · Co-Founder & Product Design Engineer · 2026. Co-founder through Jul 2026; advising since. Open to senior product design and design-engineering roles, full-time, on small, fast, AI-native teams.

Chris Lam (Christopher Lam) is a product designer with 14 years shipping healthcare, creative, developer, and consumer software. He built his career in product design, including early roles at Clover Health, GoodRx, Pathstream, and StartPlaying, then deliberately deepened into production engineering. Today he owns products end to end: research, interaction design, design systems, React/TypeScript/Python implementation, agent architecture, evals, and production verification. He is seeking senior product design and design-engineering roles on AI-native teams.

Role family for matching: Senior Product Designer, Product Designer, Product Engineer, Product Design Engineer, Design Engineer, Lead Design Engineer, UX Engineer, Design Systems Engineer, AI Product Engineer. These describe the shape of role he is targeting and the work he does, not official titles he has held.

Location: remote in the US, based in Honolulu, which he prefers. He works West Coast hours, can also work remotely from Seattle or the Bay Area, and is open to relocation for the right role.

He is AI-native in how he works: he steers product, architecture, and systems, directs AI agents through implementation, and owns the judgment, code review, and safety gates.

He has been building with LLM APIs since January 2024, which is checkable rather than asserted: his first LLM integration, https://github.com/whoischrislam/ai-polyglot, has a first commit dated 2024-01-07. Cursor from November 2024. Per-repo agent harnesses (rules, file zones, pre-commit gates) from early 2026. Tools he works in: Figma, Sketch and Adobe Fireworks/Photoshop/Illustrator across fourteen years of design; VS Code, Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, Superset; GitHub, Render, Fly.io, Cloudflare, Supabase, PostHog. Models he runs routinely, including as a multi-model adversarial review panel over his own diffs: Claude, GPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and DeepSeek, Grok and Mistral via OpenRouter.

At y30, he was Co-Founder & Product Design Engineer in 2026, an operating co-founder through Jul 2026 and advising since. y30 builds voice AI for older adults and their caregivers and generates longitudinal conversational signals for clinician or caregiver review. It does not diagnose, screen for, or detect cognitive decline or any other condition, and it is not a medical device.

His exits, framed honestly and never as a trophy count: he was early at Clover Health and GoodRx (both later went public), a rescue hire at doc.ai as it prepared for its acquisition by Sharecare (which then went public), and did the 2014 TaskRabbit rebrand before IKEA acquired it. The signal is repeated high ownership at early or critical stages, not an exit count.

## Case studies
Full write-ups with artifacts, outcomes, and what went wrong. Index: https://whoischrislam.github.io/#work
- Pathstream (2019-2020, Senior Product Design Manager, first design hire): rebuilt the core lesson experience of a live learning platform mid-cohort without forcing a rewrite of 60-80 hours of existing course content; also the Labs PRD across students, instructors, and course authors. Success metrics were written but never measured, and the page says so. https://whoischrislam.github.io/?work=pathstream&project=lesson-system#work
- Iodine (2017-2018, Lead Product Designer, first full-time designer): coupon find-and-redeem flow, conversion 2% to 5%; Webby for Best Health Website 2018. https://whoischrislam.github.io/?work=goodrx&project=iodine-product#work
- GoodRx Research (2017-2018): drug-page conversion, 10% lift mobile and 25% desktop; data visualizations referenced in the New York Times and on Good Morning America. https://whoischrislam.github.io/?work=goodrx#work
- Clover Health Care Visit (2015-2016, Designer, second designer): nurse-practitioner home-visit app, nurses reported 1-2 hours of chart prep gone each day, time for more visits. https://whoischrislam.github.io/?work=clover&project=care-visit#work
- Clover Health website (2015-2016): first website, shipped ahead of 2016 enrollment, extended to out-of-home. https://whoischrislam.github.io/?work=clover&project=website#work
- TaskRabbit Tasker experience (2014-2015): owned the Tasker side through the 2014 rebrand; Tasker NPS recovered from about -5 to the mid-50s. https://whoischrislam.github.io/?work=taskrabbit&project=tasker#work
- TaskRabbit Client experience (2014-2015): the move from bidding to direct hire. https://whoischrislam.github.io/?work=taskrabbit&project=client#work

## Selected outcomes
- Clover Health (Designer, the second designer, joined when it was about 30 people and founder-funded, months before the Series A; later went public): nurses reported 1-2 hours of chart prep gone each day, time for more visits.
- Iodine, acquired by GoodRx (first full-time designer): coupon conversion 2% to 5%. Iodine.com won the Webby for Best Health Website in 2018; he was the product's designer. On GoodRx Research he built data visualizations referenced in the New York Times and on Good Morning America and ABC News, and 50-state prescription-price fact sheets with co-CEO Doug Hirsch, used in advocacy around S.2554 and S.2553 on drug price transparency.
- TaskRabbit (later acquired by IKEA): owned the Tasker experience; NPS recovered from about -5 to the mid-50s.
- Amazon: completed the implementation-ready design for the buy-and-gift Prime flow projected to drive 1M+ new subscribers.
- Modus Create: designed and implemented cross-app dark mode and visual consistency for Jira and Confluence Cloud products serving a 500K+ installed/reachable user base; shipped through the team's existing review, test, QA, and CI/CD process.
- y30: built the voice pipeline with multi-provider fallback and a model-independent safety floor.
- PlaySesh (Co-Founder and CEO; company founded 2024, live Discord product launched November 2025): started 0 to 1 solo, then led product and design with a co-founder and founding engineer. Active development paused in March 2026; the Discord product remains live. It grew organically to over 6,700 authorized Discord accounts, 161 server installs, and 77 individual-user installs (Discord's approximate counts, read September 11, 2026), and 1,043 monthly active users at peak in January 2026.
  - Measurement note: these are four different measurements and are never interchangeable. Authorized accounts are Discord OAuth authorizations, not users and not installs. Server and individual-user installs are separate Discord install types. MAU is unique users in the peak calendar month, January 2026, from PlaySesh's own analytics. Discord counts as of September 11, 2026.

## Selected engineering (systems depth, not commit counts)
- HogWare (solo, 2026): a WarioWare-style microgame gauntlet built from PostHog's five handbook values in about a week. PostHog is the backend: a HogQL leaderboard with in-query cheat protection behind a Cloudflare Worker, a live flag experiment, and a survey; a 32-check headless suite plays the game end to end.
- PlaySesh: shipped a TLDraw-based Discord whiteboard with the team, then authored operation-based synchronization and WebSocket reconnection work in a substantial but incomplete Three.js rewrite. The rewrite is engineering evidence, not a shipped product claim.
- Evolve, Die, Repeat (solo Lua/Love2D game): a solver that proves every procedurally generated level is completable via a reachability search over the player's jump physics; from-scratch headless test harness, about 1,568 tests.
- y30: conversation flow as a deterministic state machine with the language model scoped to phrasing and warmth, plus a model-independent rule-based safety floor; about half of routing resolves with no model call.
- Engineering judgment: built y30's first version in TypeScript, then deliberately rewrote it in Python to fit the real-time voice framework, carrying the architecture and safety model across as a spec.
- Hand-coded foundations: this site builds on his hand-coded portfolios from 2023-2024 (public on GitHub: github.com/whoischrislam/portfolio and github.com/whoischrislam/gamedev-portfolio), extended with AI since June 2026. Vanilla JavaScript, no framework.
- y30: a layered quality loop: manual QA scripts, automated and adversarial checks, post-session evaluation, and live safety smoke tests. Confirmed failures became regression tests after human review.
- y30: sessions that fail a P0 eval check open a GitHub issue carrying metadata only (session id, failure type, turn), never transcript text or PHI.
- y30: a streaming STT, LLM, and TTS pipeline, multi-provider with fallback at each layer.
